title: Derivation Tracer
description: Parse a string once into a tree, then generate both leftmost and rightmost derivations showing they take the same number of steps.

steps.description: Reveal purpose: trace derivations from a parse tree for the layered grammar.
Reveal parse: recursive descent parser that builds a labelled tree from tokens.
Reveal derivation: expands one nonterminal per step, leftmost or rightmost based on parameter.

steps.question: How many steps for both derivations of num + num * num?

steps.description: Reveal main: parse tokens, then print leftmost and rightmost derivations with step counts.
Focus on E: parses E -> T or E -> E + T recursively.
Focus on T: parses T -> F or T -> T * F recursively.
Run to show leftmost derivation starts.
